programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Porcupine Puffer. Animated deep sea adventures with Captain Barnacles and his explorers. Barnacles, Kwazii and Peso venture inside a whale shark to retrieve a porcupine puffer fish.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Subtraction Somersaults. Thirteen is learning to jump and take away some blocks. What's left?

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: Giant Beanstalk. Again wants to pick apples from the top of a tree, but how can he reach them? With a giant beanstalk, of course!

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Splash About Day. Love Monster is excited to be an assistant lifeguard for the day. But when he thinks he sees a Danger Noodle in the water and exaggerates the story, the beach has to close.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Gloves. Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie play a fun game of 'Wavey Wavey Snap' using some giant, silly gloves.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Potato. Children's animation. Bing and Sula find a potato in Amma's vegetable patch with a comical face, so they take it under their wing, naming it Nosey.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: w. Dee encourages a friend to say 'w', and they go on an adventure around the sound. They play in some water, see a worm and wear some wigs!

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: The Long Goodbye. Lu finds it hard to say goodbye to her favourite uncle.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Camping Badges. The Piggies help Keith and Rebecca earn their camping badges.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: Longer. Stop-motion preschool programme about the adventures of four inquisitive Twirlywoos. The Twirlywoos watch a baker rolling out a baguette.

programme.title: Something Special: We're All Friends
programme.desc: Woof! Justin and his friends take Bonnie the dog for a wash and blow dry at the local dog groomers. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble attempts to dog train the Puppy.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Purple. Preschool series. In Tummy Tales, a boy learns to knit with purple wool and in Teletubbyland, purple Tinky Winky answers the Tubby Phone and leads the Tubby Phone Dance.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Socks. Nigel and Baby Bear invite babies and their grown-ups to explore socks through discovery, play, song and story. Babies and grown-ups at home can join in, too!

programme.title: Maddie & Triggs
programme.desc: Microwave. Maddie and Triggs discover that there is more to the microwave than just making popcorn.

programme.title: Dylan's Playtime Adventures
programme.desc: Food Scientist. Dylan the food scientist wants to invent a new kind of treat, but when his experiment takes an unexpected turn, he needs to find a sweet solution!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Empathy. Lou explains to Marzipan what hugs are for.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: The Stink Flower. Ginger and the Pea-Rexes find a stinky flower. The smell transfers to Wasabi, who hates baths.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: The Sleepover. A sleepover with their cousin means Bluey and Bingo get to stay up late!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Accessory Badge. The Squirrels see Duggee accessorising his tie and want to learn how to do it themselves. All of the Squirrels accessorise an item and showcase their goods.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
programme.desc: I'm Hungry. King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Apple. Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Apple singing in celebration of her great-great-grandad Apple Tree's hundredth birthday.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Timmy Needs a Bath. After a game of football, muddy Timmy is determined not to have a bath.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: Leon's Fruity Supermarket Trip. Leon and his class are making fruit kebabs, so they visit a local shop to buy ingredients.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Hatty the Hedgehog. The chefs are having a scavenger hunt in the cafe, finding spiky things.

programme.title: Aneeshwar and Lizzie Go Wild
programme.desc: Spider Monkey and Tamandua. Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet two amazing animals and reveal a surprising connection between them in the wild. This time, it's spider monkeys and the tamandua.

programme.title: What's in Your Bag?

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Mission: Big Bear. Therapy dog Sylvie uses her superheart to help the children on their first day at school.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?

programme.title: Yakka Dee!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Nine. Children's animation. Numberblock Nine arrives in Numberland, finds a friend in Four, sings a song about squares - and sneezes.

programme.title: Alphablocks

programme.title: Colourblocks

programme.title: Topsy and Tim

programme.title: Peter Rabbit

programme.title: Confessions of a Pop Performer
programme.desc: 1975. Comedy. Director: Norman Cohen. Stars Robin Askwith, Anthony Booth & Bill Maynard. The adventures of accident-prone, amorously inclined Timmy Lea, as he tries to achieve pop music stardom.

programme.title: Star Treatment Show
programme.desc: 1979 Southern Televisions version of 'Opportunity Knocks!' This week starring: Cannon & Ball. Young entertainers are given a chance to showcase their talent in their own production. (S1, E04)

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: During One Night
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Directed and written by Sidney J Furie. Starring Don Borisenko & Susan Hampshire. A sensitive story of two airmen. One with a terrible injury and one dealing with life.

programme.title: Nell Gwyn
programme.desc: 1934. Period drama directed by Herbert Wilcox. Nell (Anna Neagle) captivates King Charles (Cedric Hardwicke) and fights off the royal insiders.

programme.title: I'll Turn To You
programme.desc: 1946. Starring Irene Handl. A returning soldier finds readjusting to married life and civvy street very difficult. Stars Don Stannard & Terry Randall.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Love Affair. Directed by Aaron Spelling and starring Don Durant. A middle-aged saloon singer, determined to leave her abusive boyfriend, shoots him in her hotel room, then flees to Velardi.

programme.title: Look At Life Driving Test
programme.desc: 1959. Driving school tuition, including the innovative mock-up car, the junior driver course and the training of police drivers and London Bus drivers.

programme.title: Who Killed the Cat?
programme.desc: 1966. Drama. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Stars: Mary Merrall, Ellen Pollock, Mervyn Johns. A widow persecutes three old ladies, but fate takes its revenge.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Sheep Farming and Bite Indicators. 1980. Jack Hargreaves visits one of the largest sheep farms in the south of England. Then he goes fishing on the Dorset Stour to try two types of bite indicator.

programme.title: The Rossiter Case
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Directed by Francis Searle. Stars Helen Shingler, Clement McCallin & Sheila Burrell. After an accident results in her paralysis, a woman fears that her husband will abandon her.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: 1966. Enjoy this video of Bobby Rydell as he performs his wonderful song Bellazza.

programme.title: Murder at the Windmill
programme.desc: 1949. Crime Drama. Directed by Val Guest. Stars Garry Marsh, Jack Livesey & Jon Pertwee. Two London detectives order the repeat of a stage show after a spectator is shot during a performance.

programme.title: Dixon of Dock Green
programme.desc: The Team. 1967. Stars Jack Warner, Rosemarie Dunham & Vincent Ball. A group of swindlers from Leeds are operating in the local area, targeting elderly, vulnerable people. Can the team catch them?

programme.title: Wanted For Murder
programme.desc: 1946. Drama. Directed by Lawrence Huntington. Stars Eric Portman, Dulcie Gray, Derek Farr & Roland Culver. The son of a Victorian hangman is driven insane by thoughts of his father's profession...

programme.title: Cyril Fletcher Don't Take Chances
programme.desc: The 1940s tale of Billy Bart, a comedic rhyming poem about pedestrian safety and the rules of crossing the road.

programme.title: Mark of The Phoenix
programme.desc: 1957. Crime drama directed by Maclean Rogers and starring Anton Diffring. Crooks steal a secret metal formula and plan to smuggle it into East Germany.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Granny Learns to Drive. 1964. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Irene Ryan & Donna Douglas. Granny and Ellie make a police man and a cab driver think that the Clampett house is a mental institution.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1960. The Dover Road Mystery. Directed by Gerard Bryant. Starring Geoffrey Keen, Edward Cast and Leonard Sachs. A stolen car used in a bank robbery proves too fast for the squad car. (S1, E32)

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Showdown. 1960. Stars Dan Blocker, Ben Cooper & Ray Teal. After a gang robs Virginia City's bank, the youngest member gets a job on the Ponderosa to prevent the sheriff from finding the others.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Yellow Robe. 1954. Stars Ron Randell, Nicholas Hill & Tony Penderell. A monk telephones to tell Frank that his brother is alive and well in a monastery. This call leads to the monk's death.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: We're joined by 60s singer Sylvan, daughter of Jack Whittingham, with some amazing reels! We've a brilliant Scopitone and a 'Pinta' Joe Brown, and we take a trip on coin-operated rides in the 60s.

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1975. Detective & Mystery Drama. Unlucky for Some. Stars Alfred Burke, Jennifer Daniel & John Quayle. Marker bows out with a strange and intriguing case involving two Villians.

programme.title: Remember My Name
programme.desc: 1978. Drama. Director: Alan Rudolph. Stars: Geraldine Chaplin, Anthony Perkins & Moses Gunn. Just released from prison, a woman arrives in town to start a new life. Soon starting trouble.

programme.title: Framed (1992)
programme.desc: 1992. Thriller. Director: Geoffrey Sax. Stars Timothy Dalton, David Morrissey & Penélope Cruz. When DC Lawrence Jackson goes on holiday, the last person he expects to meet is an escaped criminal.

programme.title: Never Look Back
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Director: Francis Searle. Stars Rosamund John, Hugh Sinclair, Guy Middleton. A female lawyer puts her reputation on the line to defend her ex-boyfriend who has been accused of murder.

programme.title: Carry On Admiral
programme.desc: 1957. Comedy directed by Val Guest and starring David Tomlinson, Peggy Cummins & Alfie Bass. An MP is mistaken for his naval friend and put in charge of the fighting ship HMS Sherwood!

programme.title: Talking Pictures with Sally Geeson
programme.desc: Sally Geeson was perfect for the role of the innocent girl-next-door in TV sitcoms such as Bless This House, in films and on the stage. Here she talks to us exclusively about her career.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: The Assassins. 1956. Stars Hugh O'Brian, Lewis Martin & Larry J. Blake. When Wyatt sends a crooked gambler packing, three saloon owners decide they've had enough and hire gunmen to take him out.

programme.title: The Westerner
programme.desc: Jeff. 1962. Western Series created by Sam Peckinpah and stars Brian Keith. Dave travels to a distant town in order to find an old girlfriend and kill the man who is holding her.

programme.title: Salute the Toff
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Director: Maclean Rogers. Stars John Bentley and Carol Marsh. Based on the 1941 Novel. The sixth in the series featuring upper-class sleuth, Richard Rollison.

programme.title: Away for the Day in 1952
programme.desc: 1952. Directed by John Krish. A travelogue about day trips via coach. Various parties are seen visiting Dartmoor, the Roman theatre at Verulamium, the Tower of London, Brighton and Tintern Abbey.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Appleby Fair and Private Rivers. 1980. A display of vintage farm machinery is found at the annual Appleby Fair. Jack Hargreaves goes fly-fishing on a Dorset chalk stream owned by Greg Lake.

programme.title: Life with the Lyons
programme.desc: 1954. Comedy. Directed by Val Guest. Stars Bebe Daniels, Ben Lyon & Richard Lyon. Ben and Bebe Lyon, along with their family, move into a new home but face some unexpected teething problems.

programme.title: The Sicilians
programme.desc: 1964. Crime. Stars Robert Hutton, Reginald Marsh & Ursula Howells. An aide at the U.S. Embassy finds himself involved with Scotland Yard and the French police after a mafia boss' son is kidnapped.

programme.title: Dixon of Dock Green
programme.desc: Waste Land. 1970. Stars Jack Warner, Margaret John & James Grout. When a policeman goes missing under strange circumstances, his colleagues search for him using clues from his past.

programme.title: School For Secrets
programme.desc: 1946. War. Director Peter Ustinov. Stars Ralph Richardson and Richard Attenborough. During World War II, on the eve of the Battle of Britain, British scientists develop the first radar systems.

programme.title: Talk About Jacqueline
programme.desc: 1942. Comedy. Director: Harold French & Paul L. Stein. Stars Hugh Williams & Carla Lehmann. A woman meets a researcher. When they marry, he runs across some scandalous gossip about her past.

programme.title: Look At Life Turn Of The Wheel
programme.desc: 1964. A look at the modernisation of the transport system across the country, focusing on what happens to the trains and buses, the conversions of old stations and new uses for old equipment.

programme.title: Douglas Fairbanks Presents
programme.desc: Jason's House. 1956. Stars Finlay Currie, Patrick Holt & Charles Victor. A demolition crew tries to make a man leave his home of 50 years and he will not leave without putting up a strong fight.

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: Face Of A Stranger. 1964. Directed by John Llewellyn Moxey. Stars Jeremy Kemp & Bernard Archard. A prisoner is being released soon, but wishes to assume the identity of another inmate.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by Roy Kellino. Stars Dick Powell, Jean Willes & Herb Vigran. Dante runs into an old flame who reveals that the party she's with want to rob the place, but can he stop them?

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Penguin's Nest. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith & Vito Scotti. The Penguin tries to get arrested as he wants to be sent back to prison so he can team up with a forger residing there.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Rat Trap. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Thomas Gallagher & Sydney Tafler. An outbreak of organised violence mystifies the police. Maguire is assigned the case when DS Hadley is murdered.

programme.title: The Mind of Mr. J. G. Reeder

programme.title: Night of the Big Heat

programme.title: Pickup Alley
programme.desc: 1957. Crime. Directed by John Gilling. Stars Victor Mature, Anita Ekberg & Trevor Howard. An FBI agent will stop at nothing to catch the narcotics kingpin responsible for his sister's death.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Join Caroline Munro for an evening of dark tales from the 70s. First up, we become trapped in the 1973 British anthology film The Vault of Horror directed by Roy Ward Baker.

programme.title: The Vault of Horror
programme.desc: 1973. Horror. Directed by Roy Ward Baker. Stars Curd Jürgens, Terry-Thomas & Tom Baker. Five men trapped in the basement vault of an office building share visions with each other of their demise.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Don't go walking the streets alone at night! Caroline Munro follows up with the 1979 sci-fi horror The Dark, starring William Devane and Cathy Lee Crosby who team up to hunt down a savage killer.

programme.title: The Dark
programme.desc: 1979. Sci-fi Horror. Directed by John 'Bud' Cardos & Tobe Hooper. Stars William Devane & Cathy Lee Crosby. An unlikely pair are drawn together when attempting to track down a vicious alien terror.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro prepares to lock up for the night but not before giving us a sneaky peek at next week's horrifyingly terrific films.

programme.title: Remembers Sam Kydd
programme.desc: Talking Pictures TV remembers the great British actor who appeared in over 240 films and countless TV appearances as we discuss his life and career with his son, Jonathan Kydd.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: House of Violence. Western with Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray, who run a stagecoach line in the Old West where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Look At Life For Crying Out
programme.desc: ... Loud. 1964. A fascinating survey of the advertising industry, with a focus on how it works and what it does.

programme.title: The Gentle Trap
programme.desc: 1960. A locksmith on his first burglary is on the run when a rival gang wants his haul. Stars Spencer Teakle & Martin Benson.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Fishing for Barbel and Ferreting. 1980. Jack travels to the lower Hampshire Avon in search of Barbel and goes ferreting with Fred Taylor, president of the Ferreting Association of Great Britain.

programme.title: The Lady From Shanghai

programme.title: Gaolbreak

programme.title: Dixon of Dock Green

programme.title: Alma Cogan Live in 1959

programme.title: The Brothers

programme.title: Look At Life Woman Power
programme.desc: 1960. Author and broadcaster Stephen Potter shows why no man should ever underestimate the spending power of women in modern Britain, with a look at women's influence on the retail trade.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: 1951. Comedy. Director: Vincente Minnelli. Stars Elizabeth Taylor, Spencer Tracy & Joan Bennett. Stanley Banks is still recovering from his daughter's wedding when he learns that she is pregnant.

programme.title: Autobiography of a Princess
programme.desc: 1975. Drama. Director: James Ivory. Stars James Mason & Madhur Jaffrey. Divorced and living in exile in London, an Indian princess recollects about her past life in Royal India.

programme.title: Strange But True

programme.title: Man Accused

programme.title: Timeslip
